message: No detected input validation: The code parses arguments and loads configs but performs no schema, type, or value-range validation on the incoming data or configuration beyond basic argparse type coercion.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this slice, and no checksum verification, signature checks, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the shown code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The _read_checkpoint method loads model checkpoints using torch.load() with only map_location handling, but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check on the checkpoint file.
No detected label distribution validation: No code validates label distribution, checks class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any backdoor/trigger defense mechanism present in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation in the visible code.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, schema enforcement, or rejection logic is visible anywhere on the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly from config/argparse to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The visible inference code contains no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on model outputs before they are returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: There is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection present in any of the shown code files.
